title: solve.status (v1): solve.started | solve.completed
description: DRAFT by osovyk for review; owner TBD. solver -> timetable, topic solve.status, key school_id (one topic, so the partition keeps started before completed). The envelope `type` selects the payload. timetable accepts solve.started only for a queued job and solve.completed from any non-final state.

started_at.description: timetable computes run_deadline_at = started_at + time limit + margin (>= 90 s).

status.description: OPTIMAL/FEASIBLE carry a timetable (a build job) or `substitution` (a substitution job, which always has a solution: OPTIMAL or FEASIBLE, never INFEASIBLE); INFEASIBLE carries conflicts; UNKNOWN = no solution within the limit; MODEL_INVALID = technical failure, never retried (error.code says why); EXPIRED = skipped because queue_deadline_at had passed. OPTIMAL is relative to the solver's model, which includes the per-row daily cap (quality rule, ADR 2026-11-04 §1): with stats.quality_relaxed=false it is optimal among timetables that respect the cap, not necessarily for the uncapped problem of spec §04; with quality_relaxed=true the cap was dropped and the model is the spec §04 problem.

lessons.description: Weekly template; ids only (no teacher signatures). maxItems = 200 classes x 6 days x 10 lessons (solve.build.requested limits; a class has at most one lesson per slot).

error.description: Present only with status MODEL_INVALID. unsupported_job_type: the solver cannot run this kind of job; solvers before 0.4.0 answer every substitution job so (ADR 2026-11-15-solver-substitution-unsupported). The value stays for those solvers; the stage 2 engine (ADR 2026-11-15-solver-substitution-engine) answers with `substitution` instead. lessons, day_formats and conflicts are empty and no solve.started precedes it.

allOf.$comment: 0.5.0: a substitution result carries no timetable and no conflicts.

substitution.description: 0.5.0, result of a substitution job (ADR 2026-11-15-solver-substitution-engine, spec §06: 'for a substitution, the step it was found at'). Present only with OPTIMAL/FEASIBLE; lessons, day_formats and conflicts are then empty. The solver only proposes: timetable builds the effective week and validator-lib (newConflicts) gives the verdict; a person approves or picks cancelled. Invariant (not expressible in JSON Schema; checked by vectors/substitution-solve and by timetable, which rejects the result otherwise): every lesson of the request's `lessons` (the absent teacher's lessons on `date`) appears exactly once, with `date` = the request's date and the same class_id and lesson_no. Rows outside `lessons` are allowed only with kind=moved and only when the request had allow_support_moves=true (another teacher's lesson moved to make room); with allow_support_moves=false (default) there are none. No other ids are repeated: subject, original teacher and timetable_id follow from the request.

step.description: Last step the job reached = max(proposals[].step): 1 free teacher, 2 rebuild of the date, 3 neighbour dates.

proposals.description: maxItems is a static bound (JSON Schema cannot tie it to the request): far above one teacher's day (<= 10 lessons) plus the support moves of the rebuilt dates. A bigger result is replaced with MODEL_INVALID / result_too_large.

proposal.description: One proposed change of one lesson slot (date, class_id, lesson_no) of the baseline week. kind=teacher: teacher_id teaches it instead (off_profile = the substitute has no curriculum row with the lesson's subject, 'не за фахом'); kind=moved: the lesson goes to moved_to, same class, subject and teacher; kind=self_study: no teacher, the class keeps its day format. cancelled is never proposed: only a person chooses it.

step.description: Step that produced the row; for self_study the last step that ran (3 when the request had non_school_dates, else 2).

stats.description: Optional provenance and quality of a solve (shown in /load as build time; bench RQ1).

objective.description: W * primary + secondary of the best solution found.

best_bound.description: Proven upper bound of the objective of the solver's model; the gap is (best_bound - objective) / best_bound. With quality_relaxed=false the model includes the per-row daily cap, so this bounds capped timetables only and is not an upper bound for the uncapped spec §04 problem; with quality_relaxed=true it is.

input_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the validated request data.

stop_reason.description: Why the search ended. no_improvement: phase A stopped early because the objective stopped improving (status stays FEASIBLE); timetable treats it like time_limit.

quality_relaxed.description: true = the per-day row cap was dropped to find a solution (ADR quality ladder).
